claim_title: Bounded refinement and recovery diagnostics in selected frozen operator families
claim_text: Within selected frozen graph and operator families, the committed diagnostics preserve several ordered numerical structures across declared refinement and recovery tests.

selection_history.selection_rule: The public phase spine, frozen manifests, and branch lifecycle registry identify retained and closed branches; they do not establish a complete prospective record of all exploratory choices made before the earliest freezes.
selection_history.limitations: A complete historical multiverse of tried parameters, renamed candidates, and discarded telemetry is not demonstrated. No claim may treat freezing alone as evidence against prior tuning.

included: Phase XVIII refinement levels N=60,72,84 with the declared disturbance family
three-seed variation in the post-66.5 CP5 screen
perturbation_domain.applicability_statement: Recoverability is conditional on the listed perturbations, telemetry, and controls; it is not a universal property of the candidate structures.

telemetry.limitations: Frozen telemetry improves repeatability but metric independence has not been demonstrated.

tested.name: periodic_diagonal_augmented_control
tested.result: Does not reproduce the branch shell-slope and causal-depth stability in the tested Phase XVIII slice.

tested.name: generic_open_grid_scalar_block_control
tested.result: Preserves the listed Phase X projection properties strongly enough that branch-specific control separation remains unresolved.

omitted_adversarial_controls: alternative operator with matched low-frequency structure

reproduction.limitations: Repository artifact consistency is declared. This contract does not record a fresh execution in the present audit or an unaffiliated reproduction of outputs and classifications.

claim_boundary.allowed_language: Bounded refinement and recovery diagnostics preserve selected numerical structures inside the declared frozen regimes; overall scale-bridge status remains OPEN.
not_claimed: universality across substrate or kernel families
derivation or explanation of known physics
claim_boundary.downgrade_condition: Downgrade to analogy-only if reasonable alternative telemetry or stronger matched controls remove the reported separation.
claim_boundary.kill_condition: Fail the bounded scaling claim if committed reproduction fails under the frozen contract or the reported branch stability collapses under its declared perturbation domain.
